title: Complexe de De Rham à puissance divisée [conférence de 1976 à l’IHÉS] : notes manuscrites (s.d.).

deep.reconstruction:
This is a handwritten sheet on the back of a typescript page of SGA 7, Exp. IX (Néron models; the neighbouring pages are pp. 111–112 of that exposé). The handwriting belongs to the 1975–76 dossier on the divided-power de Rham complex, not to SGA 7.

Setting: k is a field, S a k-coalgebra, and S^k (read: S^∨ = Hom_k(S,k)) the dual algebra. C is a right S-comodule with coaction x ↦ Σ x_α ⊗ e_α, a finite sum, where (e_α)_{α∈A} is a basis of S and x_α ∈ C.

1. Action of the dual algebra. Each u ∈ S^∨ acts on C by u·x = Σ u(e_α) x_α. Identifying S^∨ ≅ k^A via u ↦ (u_α) = (u(e_α)), this reads u·x = Σ u_α x_α.
2. Continuity. For fixed x the map S^∨ → C, u ↦ u·x, is continuous for the topology of simple convergence (finite topology) on S^∨ and the discrete topology on C. Equivalently, S^∨ → Hom_k(C,C) is continuous for the 'simple convergence / discrete' topology on Hom_k(C,C). This is the classical characterisation of comodules as the rational (continuous, discrete) modules over the pseudo-compact algebra S^∨.
3. Graded case. Suppose S = ⊕ S_n is graded with Δ compatible with the grading (the triangle presumably marks Δ). Then S^∨ = Π_n (S_n)^∨ is a 'product-graded' algebra. For a graded comodule C = ⊕ C_n, the dual C^∨ = Π (C_n)^∨ is a product-graded S^∨-module.
4. Degree check. If u ∈ (S^∨)_n, its transpose sends (C_m)^∨ to (C_{m+n})^∨, so u acts on C as C_{m+n} → C_m, i.e. it lowers degrees by n. Grothendieck notes with an exclamation mark that to make it raise degrees one must reverse the grading of C, i.e. set (C^∨)^m := (C_{-m})^∨.

Purpose: this is bookkeeping for the duality between divided-power structures and (symmetric) coalgebra/differential-operator structures underlying the PD de Rham complex. Typical instances are the divided-power algebra as the graded dual of the symmetric coalgebra, and PD-differential operators as the dual of the PD-envelope of the diagonal. The point is fixing the sign and degree conventions so that the actions go in the desired direction.
errors: No mathematical error. The sign issue is caught by Grothendieck himself: with the naive conventions, elements of degree n in the dual algebra lower degree on the comodule. The parenthetical regrading fixes this.
Minor gap: the continuity claim on Hom_k(C,C) is stated loosely ('top. de conv. simple - discrète ...') and left unfinished, but it is standard.

ideas.what: A comodule over a coalgebra S is a module over the dual algebra S^∨ via u·x = Σ u(e_α) x_α, and these modules are exactly the continuous (rational) ones for the finite topology on S^∨ and the discrete topology on C.
ideas.modern_name: Comodules = rational / discrete modules over the pseudo-compact dual algebra
ideas.usually_credited_to: Cartier; Sweedler (Hopf Algebras, 1969); Gabriel (pseudo-compact rings, 1962); Demazure–Gabriel
ideas.where_published: Related comodule/linear-representation formalism appears in SGA 3 Exp. I; exact statement unsure

ideas.what: For a graded coalgebra the dual is the product-graded algebra Π (S_n)^∨. Elements of dual degree n lower comodule degree by n, so a sign change of the grading is needed for them to raise it.
ideas.modern_name: Graded duals of graded coalgebras/comodules; grading-sign conventions

deep.surprise_reason: Routine scratch work fixing conventions for comodule/dual-module duality and grading signs, presumably preparation for the divided-power de Rham complex lecture. Nothing beyond textbook material (Sweedler, Gabriel pseudo-compact duality). The only mild curiosity is that it is written on the back of an SGA 7 IX typescript page.
transcription_corrections: 'S^k' should most likely be read as the linear dual S^∨ (Grothendieck's check notation); likewise C^k = C^∨ and V(C_m) is probably the dual of C_m.
'(graduée Δ)' likely means the grading is compatible with the comultiplication Δ (the triangle is the symbol Δ).
The first line probably reads 'On voit que ceci équivaut à ∀x∈C, l'application i_x : u ↦ u_C x, S^∨ → C est dans C ⊗_k S'.
'continue via [?] C top. discrète' should read 'continue pour la top. discrète sur C et la top. de convergence simple sur S^∨'.
'Hom_k(C,C)'s topology' should read 'la top. de la convergence simple, C étant discret'.
The last line reads 'plutôt exiger que V(C)^m =déf V(C_{-m})', i.e. a regrading of the dual by negative degrees.
The note on the page is a handwritten verso over a typed SGA 7 Exp. IX page (pp. 111–112), not part of that typescript text.
